1	# Instant Resume Ranker (Rankora)
2	
3	AI-powered resume screening SaaS. Users paste a job description, upload resumes, and the system scores/ranks candidates using GPT-4o.
4	
5	## Stack
6	
7	- **Frontend:** React 18.3 + TypeScript, Vite (dev port 8080), React Router 6
8	- **UI:** Tailwind CSS 3.4 + shadcn-ui, Lucide icons, Sonner toasts, Recharts
9	- **State:** React Query 5 (server state), React Hook Form + Zod (forms)
10	- **Backend:** Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Edge Functions + Storage)
11	- **AI:** OpenAI GPT-4o (resume analysis, JD parsing, scoring)
12	- **Payments:** Dodo Payments (subscriptions + one-time credit packs, hosted checkout)
13	- **Email:** Resend (transactional notifications) + inbound webhook (resume ingestion)
14	- **Vectors:** pgvector extension with HNSW indexes
15	
16	## Folder Structure

20	├── pages/                          # Route pages
21	│   ├── Index.tsx                   # Main dashboard (sidebar + detail view)

99	
100	## Database Models (Supabase/PostgreSQL)
101	
102	- **profiles** — user_id, credits, plan, inbox_email, email_enabled
103	- **jobs** — user_id, job_description, title, status (pending|processing|completed|failed), scoring weights (must/nice/optional), jd_analysis_json, dynamic_weights_json, jd_embedding (vector)
104	- **resumes** — job_id, filename, file_path, candidate_name, status (pending|done|failed), parsed_json, parsed_text, embedding (vector)
105	- **results** — resume_id, job_id, overall_score, skill_score, experience_score, education_score, missing_skills[], red_flags, matched_must_haves, missing_must_haves, category_scores_json, confidence, hard_fit, strengths_json, gaps_json, explanation_json, interview_questions[]
106	- **users / user_roles** — auth + role enum (admin|user), helper: has_role(), is_job_owner()
107	- **plans** — name, price, credits, billing_type, dodo_product_id, active
108	- **credit_packs** — name, price, credits, active, is_trial, dodo_product_id, dodo_credit_entitlement_id
109	- **payments** — user_id, amount, credits_purchased, status, dodo_payment_id
110	- **feature_flags** — key (unique), enabled, label, description, value_json, category
111	- **platform_config** — singleton: max_resumes_per_job, max_file_size_mb, resume_retention_days, email_ingestion_enabled, payg_per_resume_cost
112	- **ranking_config** — system prompt, model name, temperature, weights
113	- **seo_settings / seo_pages** — meta tags, OG, structured data, analytics
114	- **email_templates** — customizable outbound emails
115	- **admin_audit_logs** — admin_user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details
116	- **feedback / score_versions** — model evaluation data
117	- **email_ingest_logs** — user_id, job_id, sender, status, attachments_count
118	- **usage_logs** — user_id, job_id, credits_used
119	- **subscription_webhooks** — Dodo Payments webhook audit trail
120	
121	## Component Dependency Map
122	
123	```
124	App.tsx → AuthProvider → QueryClientProvider → BrowserRouter
125	├── Index.tsx
126	│   ├── AppHeader (useAuth, useNavigate)
127	│   ├── JobSidebar (pastJobs[], selectedJobId, onSelectJob, onDeleteJob)
128	│   ├── JobDetailView (useAuth, usePlatformConfig, useFeatureFlags)
129	│   │   ├── ScoreSummaryCards (results[])
130	│   │   ├── CandidateRow (result, resume, expanded, onToggle)
131	│   │   └── AuthDialog → AuthForm
132	│   └── AuthDialog
133	├── Auth.tsx → AppHeader, AuthForm
134	├── Settings.tsx → AppHeader, AccountInfoCard, EmailInboxCard, ChangePasswordCard, UsageHistoryCard, PaymentHistoryCard
135	├── Admin.tsx → AppHeader, AdminSidebar, [DashboardTab|UsersTab|BillingTab|...]
136	└── NotFound.tsx
137	```
138	
139	## Architecture Rules
140	
141	1. **Auth-first:** All data access uses Supabase RLS policies. Never bypass auth.
142	2. **shadcn-ui only:** Use components from `src/components/ui/`. No other UI libraries.
143	3. **Path aliases:** Always import with `@/` prefix (maps to `src/`).
144	4. **React Query:** All server state via React Query hooks. No raw `useEffect` for data fetching.
145	5. **Single Supabase client:** Import from `@/integrations/supabase/client.ts`. Never create new clients.
146	6. **Edge Functions:** Business logic in Supabase Edge Functions (Deno). Frontend calls via `supabase.functions.invoke()`.
147	7. **Credits system:** All ranking operations deduct credits via `deduct_credits()` DB function.
148	8. **Admin audit:** Log all admin mutations via `logAuditAction()` from `@/lib/auditLog.ts`.
149	9. **No hardcoded secrets:** All keys via environment variables (VITE_ prefix for frontend).
150	10. **Auto-generated types:** `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` is auto-generated. Do not manually edit.
151	11. **Sonner toasts:** Use `toast.success()`, `toast.error()` from sonner. No other notification system.
152	12. **Error handling:** Try-catch with toast for user-facing errors. Validation errors as arrays displayed inline.
153	13. **Real-time subscriptions:** Feature flags and SEO settings use Supabase real-time subscriptions + React Query invalidation.
154	
155	## Key Data Flows
156	
157	### Resume Ranking Pipeline
158	```
159	User enters JD + uploads files
160	→ validateFields() checks input
161	→ Create job record (status: pending)
162	→ analyzeJd() → analyze-jd edge function → stores jd_analysis_json
163	→ uploadFilesFromSnapshot() → Supabase Storage + resume records
164	→ rank-resumes edge function (GPT-4o scoring, skill matching)
165	→ rankAndPoll() polls job.status every 2s (max 60 iterations)
166	→ Fetch results from results table
167	→ Merge with resume data, sort by overall_score desc
168	→ Display ScoreSummaryCards + CandidateRow list
169	→ refreshProfile() updates credit count
170	```
171	
172	### Credit System
173	```
174	Check profiles.credits ≥ required
175	→ deduct_credits(user_id, amount) [atomic DB function]
176	→ Log to usage_logs
177	→ Proceed with AI operation
178	→ On failure: no auto-refund (credits already deducted)
179	```
180	
181	### Payment Flows
182	```
183	One-time: BuyCreditsDialog → create-dodo-checkout → redirect to Dodo hosted checkout → dodo-webhook → add credits → PaymentCallback verifies
184	Subscription: SubscriptionDialog → create-dodo-checkout (subscription product) → Dodo checkout → dodo-webhook → update plan+credits
185	Cancellation: cancel-dodo-subscription → plan active until subscription_ends_at → check-expired-subscriptions (cron) → downgrade to free
186	```
187	
188	## Known Code Patterns
189	
190	- **Polling pattern:** `rankAndPoll()` in JobDetailView uses setInterval with iteration counter
191	- **Ref tracking:** `rankingFilesRef` and `resultsRef` track state outside React lifecycle
192	- **Feature flag defaults:** `useFeatureFlag()` returns `enabled: false` before loading (race condition potential)
193	- **SEO type workaround:** `(supabase as any)` cast for seo_settings/seo_pages (not in auto-generated types)
194	- **Dodo hosted checkout:** Both BuyCreditsDialog and SubscriptionDialog use create-dodo-checkout for redirect-based payment
195	- **Admin section mapping:** `sectionComponents` object in Admin.tsx maps section names to components
196	
197	## Commands
198	
199	```bash
200	npm install          # Install dependencies
201	npm run dev          # Start dev server (localhost:8080)
202	npm run build        # Production build
203	npm run test         # Run tests (Vitest)
204	npm run test:watch   # Watch mode tests
205	npx eslint .         # Lint
206	
207	# Supabase
208	supabase functions deploy <name>
209	supabase db push
210	supabase gen types typescript --project-id zkzontawprihrzpayeam > src/integrations/supabase/types.ts
211	```
212	
213	## Safety Rules (CRITICAL)
214	
215	1. **NEVER delete or overwrite existing data/files without explicit user request**
216	2. **NEVER modify payment/billing logic without careful review** — broken payments = lost revenue
217	3. **NEVER change RLS policies without understanding the full security impact**
218	4. **NEVER modify `types.ts`** — it is auto-generated
219	5. **NEVER hardcode API keys, URLs with secrets, or credentials**
220	6. **ALWAYS run `npm run build` after changes to verify no type errors**
221	7. **ALWAYS preserve existing error handling** — do not remove try-catch blocks
222	8. **ALWAYS maintain backward compatibility** — existing API contracts must not break
223	9. **When in doubt, ask the user** — never guess about business logic

1	-- ============================================================
2	-- CAREER PAGE FEATURE
3	-- ============================================================
4	-- Depends on:
5	--   • public.teams                         (20260407100000)
6	--   • public.jobs                          (initial schema + 20260407100000)
7	--   • public.is_team_admin()               (20260407100000)

9	-- ============================================================
10	
11	
12	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
13	-- 1. career_page_config TABLE
14	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
15	
16	CREATE TABLE public.career_page_config (
17	  id           uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
18	  team_id      uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE UNIQUE,
19	  slug         text        NOT NULL UNIQUE,
20	  company_name text        NOT NULL,
21	  logo_url     text,
22	  brand_color  text        NOT NULL DEFAULT '#6366f1',
23	  tagline      text,
24	  about        text,
25	  is_active    boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
26	  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
27	  updated_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
28	);
29	
30	-- Slug validation: lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, 3-60 chars,
31	-- must start and end with alphanumeric character
32	ALTER TABLE public.career_page_config
33	  ADD CONSTRAINT career_page_slug_format
34	  CHECK (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9\-]{1,58}[a-z0-9]$');
35	
36	-- Brand color must be a valid 6-digit hex color
37	ALTER TABLE public.career_page_config

39	  CHECK (brand_color ~ '^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$');
40	
41	-- Indexes
42	CREATE INDEX idx_career_page_slug   ON public.career_page_config(slug);
43	CREATE INDEX idx_career_page_team   ON public.career_page_config(team_id);
44	
45	-- updated_at trigger (reuses existing function from initial schema)
46	CREATE TRIGGER update_career_page_config_updated_at
47	  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.career_page_config
48	  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();
49	
50	
51	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
52	-- 2. EXTEND jobs TABLE
53	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
54	
55	ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS location        text;
56	ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS department      text;
57	ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS employment_type text DEFAULT 'Full-time';
58	ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS salary_range    text;
59	ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_published    boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;
60	
61	-- Index to efficiently query published jobs by team
62	CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_is_published_team
63	  ON public.jobs(team_id, is_published)
64	  WHERE is_published = true;
65	
66	
67	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
68	-- 3. RLS FOR career_page_config
69	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
70	
71	ALTER TABLE public.career_page_config ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
72	
73	-- Public (anon + authenticated) can view ACTIVE career pages
74	-- Used by the public /careers/:slug route
75	CREATE POLICY "Anyone can view active career pages"
76	  ON public.career_page_config FOR SELECT
77	  TO anon, authenticated
78	  USING (is_active = true);
79	
80	-- Team admins can view their own config regardless of is_active
81	-- Required for the settings/management page
82	CREATE POLICY "Team admins can view own career config"
83	  ON public.career_page_config FOR SELECT
84	  TO authenticated
85	  USING (public.is_team_admin(auth.uid(), team_id));
86	
87	-- Team admins can create a career page config for their team
88	CREATE POLICY "Team admins can manage career config"
89	  ON public.career_page_config FOR INSERT
90	  TO authenticated
91	  WITH CHECK (public.is_team_admin(auth.uid(), team_id));
92	
93	-- Team admins can update their team's career page config
94	CREATE POLICY "Team admins can update career config"
95	  ON public.career_page_config FOR UPDATE
96	  TO authenticated
97	  USING (public.is_team_admin(auth.uid(), team_id));
98	
99	-- Team admins can delete their team's career page config
100	CREATE POLICY "Team admins can delete career config"
101	  ON public.career_page_config FOR DELETE
102	  TO authenticated
103	  USING (public.is_team_admin(auth.uid(), team_id));
104	
105	
106	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
107	-- 4. PUBLIC RPC — get_career_page
108	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
109	-- Returns the career page config + published jobs for a given slug.
110	-- SECURITY DEFINER so it can bypass RLS to read jobs/config
111	-- for the unauthenticated public careers page.
112	-- search_path is pinned to prevent search_path injection.
113	
114	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_career_page(p_slug text)
115	RETURNS jsonb
116	LANGUAGE plpgsql
117	SECURITY DEFINER
118	STABLE
119	SET search_path = public
120	AS $$
121	DECLARE
122	  _config record;
123	  _jobs   jsonb;
124	BEGIN
125	  -- Fetch career page config (active only — public endpoint)
126	  SELECT id, team_id, slug, company_name, logo_url, brand_color, tagline, about
127	  INTO   _config
128	  FROM   public.career_page_config
129	  WHERE  slug = p_slug
130	    AND  is_active = true;
131	
132	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
133	    RETURN NULL;
134	  END IF;
135	
136	  -- Fetch published, non-failed jobs for this team
137	  SELECT COALESCE(
138	    jsonb_agg(
139	      jsonb_build_object(
140	        'id',              j.id,
141	        'title',           j.title,
142	        'location',        j.location,
143	        'department',      j.department,
144	        'employment_type', j.employment_type,
145	        'salary_range',    j.salary_range,
146	        'created_at',      j.created_at
147	      ) ORDER BY j.created_at DESC
148	    ),
149	    '[]'::jsonb
150	  )
151	  INTO _jobs
152	  FROM public.jobs j
153	  WHERE j.team_id     = _config.team_id
154	    AND j.is_published = true
155	    AND j.status      != 'failed';
156	
157	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
158	    'config', jsonb_build_object(
159	      'company_name', _config.company_name,
160	      'logo_url',     _config.logo_url,
161	      'brand_color',  _config.brand_color,
162	      'tagline',      _config.tagline,
163	      'about',        _config.about
164	    ),
165	    'jobs', _jobs
166	  );
167	END;
168	$$;
169	
170	GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_career_page(text) TO anon, authenticated;
171	
172	COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.get_career_page(text) IS
173	  'Public RPC: returns career page config + published jobs for a slug. Safe for unauthenticated callers — only exposes active pages and published jobs.';
174	
175	
176	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
177	-- 5. SLUG AVAILABILITY RPC — is_career_slug_available
178	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
179	-- Returns true if p_slug is not taken by any team other than
180	-- p_team_id (pass p_team_id when checking for an existing team
181	-- updating its own slug).
182	-- Authenticated-only — slug availability is not public API.
183	
184	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_career_slug_available(
185	  p_slug    text,
186	  p_team_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
187	)
188	RETURNS boolean
189	LANGUAGE sql
190	SECURITY DEFINER
191	STABLE
192	SET search_path = public
193	AS $$
194	  SELECT NOT EXISTS (
195	    SELECT 1
196	    FROM public.career_page_config
197	    WHERE slug = p_slug
198	      AND (p_team_id IS NULL OR team_id != p_team_id)
199	  );
200	$$;
201	
202	GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_career_slug_available(text, uuid) TO authenticated;
203	
204	COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.is_career_slug_available(text, uuid) IS
205	  'Returns true if the slug is not already taken by another team. Pass p_team_id to exclude the callers own team (for update-slug flows).';
206	
207	
208	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
209	-- 6. TABLE COMMENT
210	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
211	
212	COMMENT ON TABLE public.career_page_config IS
213	  'One career page config per team. Slug drives the public /careers/:slug route. is_active must be true for the page to be publicly visible.';

**Step 1: Create DB migration for analytics**

input.content:
-- ============================================================
-- CAREER PAGE ANALYTICS — View & Apply Tracking
-- ============================================================
-- Depends on:
--   • public.jobs                          (initial schema + 20260407300000)
--   • public.applications                  (initial schema)
-- ============================================================

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. job_views TABLE
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE public.job_views (
  id          uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  job_id      uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  viewer_ip   text,
  referrer    text,
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_job_views_job     ON public.job_views(job_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_job_views_created ON public.job_views(job_id, created_at);

ALTER TABLE public.job_views ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Anyone (anon + authenticated) can insert view events from public career pages
CREATE POLICY "Public can track views"
  ON public.job_views FOR INSERT
  TO anon, authenticated
  WITH CHECK (true);

-- Only the job owner or a team member can read view analytics
CREATE POLICY "Job team can view analytics"
  ON public.job_views FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.jobs j
      LEFT JOIN public.team_members tm
        ON tm.team_id = j.team_id AND tm.user_id = auth.uid()
      WHERE j.id = job_views.job_id
        AND (j.user_id = auth.uid() OR tm.user_id IS NOT NULL)
    )
  );

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. Add denormalised counters to jobs for fast reads
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS view_count  integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS apply_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 3. RPC — increment_job_view (SECURITY DEFINER)
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Called by the public CareerJobDetail page on mount.
-- Inserts a view record AND bumps the denormalised view_count.
-- EXCEPTION block makes it a no-op if anything goes wrong so it
-- never breaks the page for the visitor.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_job_view(
  p_job_id   uuid,
  p_ip       text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_referrer text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.job_views (job_id, viewer_ip, referrer)
  VALUES (p_job_id, p_ip, p_referrer);

  UPDATE public.jobs
  SET view_count = view_count + 1
  WHERE id = p_job_id;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  -- Silently swallow errors — tracking must never crash the public page
  NULL;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.increment_job_view(uuid, text, text) TO anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.increment_job_view(uuid, text, text) TO authenticated;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.increment_job_view(uuid, text, text) IS
  'Public RPC: logs a job view event and bumps the denormalised view_count on jobs. Safe for anon callers. Errors are swallowed.';

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 4. TRIGGER — auto-increment apply_count on new application
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_apply_count()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.jobs
  SET apply_count = apply_count + 1
  WHERE id = NEW.job_id;
  RETURN NEW;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  -- Never block an application insert due to counter failure
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- Drop existing trigger if it exists (idempotent re-run safety)
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_increment_apply_count ON public.applications;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_increment_apply_count
  AFTER INSERT ON public.applications
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.increment_apply_count();

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.increment_apply_count() IS
  'Trigger function: increments jobs.apply_count when a new application row is inserted.';
